segments.text:
V. 29.
To him that ſmiteth thee on the cheek—Taketh away thy cloke— Theſe ſeem to be proverbial Expreſſions, to ſignify an Invaſion of the tendereſt Points of Honour and Property. Offer the other—Forbid not thy coat—That is, rather yield to his repeating the Affront or Injury, than gratify Reſentment in righting yourſelf, in any Method not becoming Chriſtian Love.
